SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：N. 935 / 30 6 41）

Special Branch Station. File No. Date June 27, 1941

SUBJECT: Friedrich REDLINGER - German (Austrian)
Jewish refugee - Communication from
British Consulate-General, Shanghai.

The details contained in the attached
communication have been checked and are correct.
Enquiries made in competent local circles reveal
nothing of a detrimental nature to Mr. REDLINGER'S
character. Nothing is known by this office
to his detriment.

He can be regarded as a trustworthy person,
anti-Nazi in his outlook on life, whose sole desire
at the moment is to proceed to Burma where he
will be able to earn enough to keep him in daily
bread. He is at present unemployed.

（批：lz 27/6）

J.A. Pires
D.S.I.

A.C. (Special Branch).

（批：OK -）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：N. 935 / 30 6 41）

特别支部警署。档案号。日期 1941年6月27日

事由：弗里德里希·雷德林格（Friedrich REDLINGER）——德国（奥地利）犹太难民——来自英国驻上海总领事馆的公函。

所附公函中的详情业经核查，确属无误。向当地有关方面进行的查询显示，雷德林格先生的品行并无任何不良记录。本处未掌握任何对其不利的信息。

他可被视为一位值得信赖的人士，其人生观持反纳粹立场，目前的唯一愿望是前往缅甸，在那里他将能够赚取足以维持日常生计的收入。他目前处于失业状态。

（批：lz 27/6）

J.A. Pires
副督察

助理 commissioner （特别支部）。

（批：OK -）

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL.
SHANGHAI.
SF 935
20th June 1940. 141

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I should be grateful for any additional in-
formation you can give me about Friedrich Redlinger, an
Austrian Jew, residing at No. 232/16 Avenue du Roi Albert.
He was born at Vienna on 24th May 1901 and was I understand,
employed as a printer by Messrs. De La Rue & Company until
they closed down in Shanghai.

The company now wish to employ Mr. Redlinger in
Rangoon and the Burma Government have authorised me to
issue the necessary visa, provided I am absolutely certain
as to his trustworthiness and bona fides.

Can you assist me please in establishing Mr.
Redlinger's trustworthiness and bona fides? I have seen
him several times and have formed a favourable opinion.

I should be most grateful if you can help.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

英国驻上海总领事馆。
上海。
SF 935
1940年6月20日。141

亲爱的夏曼先生：

如蒙告知关于弗里德里希·雷德林格（Friedrich Redlinger）的任何补充信息，我将不胜感激。此人系奥地利犹太人，居住于阿尔贝特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）232/16号。据我了解，他于1901年5月24日出生于维也纳，受雇于德拉鲁公司（Messrs. De La Rue & Company）担任印刷工，直至该公司在上海停业。

该公司现希望雇佣雷德林格先生前往仰光，缅甸政府已授权我签发必要的签证，前提是我能绝对确信其为人可靠且身份真实。

能否请您协助我核实雷德林格先生的可靠性及身份真实性？我曾数次与他见面，并已形成良好印象。

如蒙相助，我将感激不尽。

此致

敬礼，

V. Sharman, Esquire,
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
